StageAttention: ['He cast aside his real body and stole a false name, wandering through the shadows of the network. In the end, the Sixth Sin became the cage that trapped him.', "The Pseudo-Unwinged extends a light blade from the leg, sweeps out with a horizontal kick, then brings it down in a vertical slam. The Pseudo-Unwinged subsequently rolls to the target's right and thrusts, then calls in drones for a sweeping AOE attack.", 'The Pseudo-Unwinged has drones form a power gate, then fires pulse beams from the arm cannon. Once the beams pass through the gate, they are amplified into Overload Rays.', 'The Pseudo-Unwinged blinks into the air and becomes invisible while sending a swarm of drones to attack. Try to parry the drones. Perform three successful parries to hack them back and knock the Pseudo-Unwinged out of the sky.', "The Pseudo-Unwinged uses drones to restrict the target's movement, breaks through their defenses, then hacks into their consciousness to cause internal damage.", 'The Pseudo-Unwinged has drones merge into a shuriken, takes off, then dives down to slash at the target. After pulling back and sweeping across with a backhand strike, the Pseudo-Unwinged closes in again for continuous spinning slashes, then retreats and lands as the drones break apart and open fire on the target.', 'The Pseudo-Unwinged has drones merge into a twin-blade, dives at the target, continuously spins to slash, retreats, then closes in again for continuous slashes.', 'The Pseudo-Unwinged combines drones into a laser sword, retreats, and unleashes energy slashes.', 'The Pseudo-Unwinged triggers a major blackout. Three massive AOE beam attacks from the drone matrix will sweep the battlefield. Meanwhile, the Pseudo-Unwinged will continuously perform spinning slashes on targets. Note: Signal Orb Skills are disabled during this period. Try to counter the Pseudo-Unwinged through consecutive parries, which helps avoid the incoming AOE DMG.']
